{"id":1934391674,"question_id":4002,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1772341089,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1934391674/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Subarrays With K Distinct Integers","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long countSubarrays(vector<int>& nums, int k, int m) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n\n        unordered_map<int, int> mp;\n        long long cnt = 0;\n\n        int i = 0;\n        int j = 0;\n        int goodcnt = 0;\n        // long long prefix = 0;\n\n        while (j < n) {\n            mp[nums[j]]++;\n\n            if (mp[nums[j]] == m)\n                goodcnt++;\n\n            while (mp.size() > k) {\n\n                if (mp[nums[i]] == m)\n                    goodcnt--;\n                mp[nums[i]]--;\n                if (mp[nums[i]] == 0)\n                    mp.erase(nums[i]);\n                i++;\n                // prefix=0;\n            }\n\n            while (mp[nums[i]] > m) {\n                mp[nums[i]]--;\n                i++;\n                // prefix++;\n            }\n\n            if (mp.size() == k && goodcnt == k) {\n                cnt += 1;\n            }\n            j++;\n        }\n\n        return cnt;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-subarrays-with-k-distinct-integers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1761}
